notes.title: For all fans of Tetris and Match3 - Steam release on this week
notes.notes:
Triblock is the puzzle game. Combine 3 or more same block in any direction for remove defined figure. Sounds easy.

The game will be available on Windows, Mac and Linux.

Thanks for your attention! I hope all fans of puzzles, Tetris and match 3 will enjoy the game.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1518890]Triblock Steam page[/url]

notes.title: Chill the Piro Update 2.0
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24529644/9ab58b4eb9d77091079c85fc8b72cccd13e7c988.png[/img]

In new version:

1. Changed the design of the menu, screens and game interface in the direction of greater clarity.
2. Information about how to play (some tutorials) we placed at the start of the first levels.
3. At the beginning of each level added a description of what to do (to meet the time, to put out all the fires and etc).
4. A little simplified initial levels.
5. In the mini-game switch direction of the dwellers initiated by click on them.
6. Cleaned the levels from unnecessary game elements.
7. Fixed other minor bugs.

Thanks for your attention. :piro:

notes.title: Game updating is planned
notes.notes:
We are prepare an update, which will take the wishes of the players, our own improvements and enhancements since the release and the emergence of different versions of our game on other platforms besides steam.

Roughly the 2nd quarter of 2018. Thanks for your attention.
